[ID] Dasar keputusan dalam finance and cost untuk business continuity and resilience?
[EN] What decision criteria should guide Business continuity and resilience — Finance and cost?
[DOMAIN] Medic & Clinic Management & Services
back:
[ID] Bandingkan mutu layanan, kapasitas, total cost of ownership, kepatuhan, risiko, dampak sosial-lingkungan, dan ketahanan.
[EN] Compare service quality, capacity, total cost of ownership, compliance, risks, social-environmental impacts, and resilience.

term: Business continuity and resilience — Compliance and governance
front:
[ID] Definisi compliance and governance untuk business continuity and resilience?
[EN] What is the definition of Business continuity and resilience — Compliance and governance?
[DOMAIN] Medic & Clinic Management & Services
back:
[ID] Business continuity and resilience adalah proses terstandar untuk mendukung layanan Medic & Clinic Management & Services.
[EN] Business continuity and resilience is a controlled process supporting the Medic & Clinic Management & Services service line.

term: Business continuity and resilience — Compliance and governance
front:
[ID] Fungsi utama compliance and governance untuk business continuity and resilience?
[EN] What is the main function of Business continuity and resilience — Compliance and governance?
[DOMAIN] Medic & Clinic Management & Services
back:
[ID] Fungsinya menyelaraskan business continuity and resilience dengan kebutuhan layanan, kapasitas, keselamatan, dan target operasi.
[EN] It aligns business continuity and resilience with service demand, capacity, safety, and operational targets.

term: Business continuity and resilience — Compliance and governance
front:
[ID] Manfaat utama compliance and governance untuk business continuity and resilience?
[EN] What are the main benefits of Business continuity and resilience — Compliance and governance?
[DOMAIN] Medic & Clinic Management & Services
back:
[ID] Manfaatnya mencakup keandalan layanan, visibilitas, produktivitas, utilisasi aset, dan kendali biaya.
[EN] Benefits include service reliability, visibility, productivity, asset utilisation, and cost control.

term: Business continuity and resilience — Compliance and governance
front:
[ID] Risiko utama compliance and governance untuk business continuity and resilience?
[EN] What are the main risks affecting Business continuity and resilience — Compliance and governance?
[DOMAIN] Medic & Clinic Management & Services
back:
[ID] Risiko yang perlu dinilai meliputi keterlambatan, kegagalan layanan, insiden HSE, ketidakpatuhan, dan biaya tak terencana.
[EN] Assess delay, service failure, HSE incidents, non-compliance, and unplanned cost exposure.

term: Business continuity and resilience — Compliance and governance
front:
[ID] Data yang perlu dicatat untuk compliance and governance untuk business continuity and resilience?
[EN] What data should be recorded for Business continuity and resilience — Compliance and governance?
[DOMAIN] Medic & Clinic Management & Services
back:
[ID] Catat pemilik, waktu, status, kapasitas, bukti pelaksanaan, penyimpangan, dan hasil verifikasi.
[EN] Record owner, time, status, capacity, execution evidence, exceptions, and verification results.

term: Business continuity and resilience — Compliance and governance
front:
[ID] Pengendalian yang diperlukan untuk compliance and governance untuk business continuity and resilience?
[EN] What controls are required for Business continuity and resilience — Compliance and governance?
[DOMAIN] Medic & Clinic Management & Services
back:
[ID] Gunakan RACI, SOP, checklist, batas operasi, segregasi tugas, audit trail, dan jalur eskalasi.
[EN] Use a RACI, SOPs, checklists, operating limits, segregation of duties, audit trails, and escalation.

term: Business continuity and resilience — Compliance and governance
front:
[ID] Teknologi yang relevan untuk compliance and governance untuk business continuity and resilience?
[EN] Which technologies are relevant to Business continuity and resilience — Compliance and governance?
[DOMAIN] Medic & Clinic Management & Services
back:
[ID] Pilih teknologi berdasarkan kebutuhan proses, interoperabilitas, keamanan siber, integritas data, dan kesiapan pengguna.
[EN] Select technology for process fit, interoperability, cybersecurity, data integrity, and user readiness.
